failure_modes.cause: Vapour pressure of acetonitrile exceeds pump inlet pressure at T > 50°C
failure_modes.mitigation: Pressurise feed reservoir to 0.5 bar above vapour pressure

failure_modes.cause: Particulate matter or crystallization in the flow path
failure_modes.mitigation: Install inline filters and ensure complete solubility of reactants

failure_modes.cause: Unexpected temperature rise causing solvent expansion
failure_modes.mitigation: Implement temperature monitoring and automatic shutdown

single_points_of_failure: BPR valve — blockage stops all flow
validation_experiments: Run blank acetonitrile at Q=0.08744 mL/min for 60 min; monitor pressure for drift > 5%
Test BPR valve with particulate-laden solvent to assess blockage risk
Simulate thermal expansion scenario by gradually increasing temperature to 60°C and monitor pressure response
